[EN] No one has seen Seren since the heavenly home of the gods was sealed. I know it's her power that keeps us poporis and elins safe, though.

The queen used to deliver Seren's oracles, but she hasn't left the palace for as long as anyone can remember.

What a shame.
[ES] Nadie ha visto a Seren desde que el hogar celestial de los dioses fue sellado. Sin embargo, sé que es su poder el que nos mantiene a salvo a los poporis y elins.

La reina solía transmitir los oráculos de Seren, pero no ha salido del palacio desde que se tenga memoria.

Qué pena.
